after_entry: Only ordinary _process and read-only observations; no RNG/NPC/resource/skill/route/position/HP/ending changes or manual game ticks.
entry_actions: finish already-known tutorial for isolated chapter measurement
clear initial L1 dialogue before chapter fixture
production unlock_street/enter_room only if named explicit Street fixture
frame_sample: Distance accumulated every actual process frame. Visible actor and available skill durations sampled at 0.25s and therefore approximate to one sample; crossing teleports excluded from metres.
scope: Automatic autonomous host baseline, not human-paced play or proof that the player should help escape. NPC obstruction is passive benefit to the opposing player, measured separately from player input opportunities.
